maddeler.e:
أتمسخر (form IIq)
# أَتَمَسْخَرُ (ʔatamasḵaru) /ʔa.ta.mas.xa.ru/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَمَسْخَرَ (tamasḵara)
# أَتَمَسْخَرَ (ʔatamasḵara) /ʔa.ta.mas.xa.ra/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَمَسْخَرَ (tamasḵara)
# أَتَمَسْخَرْ (ʔatamasḵar) /ʔa.ta.mas.xar/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَمَسْخَرَ (tamasḵara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
